ground_truth.title: New to WoodWorking Forum
ground_truth.main_content:
Hi all.
My name is Doug Kitchen. I'm a little crafty, love helping the kids with their school projects. I try my best to make good stuff. I have a laser engraver which I have had fun with. I want to create something new to me. I have some tools - scroll saw, sander, Dremel. I like small projects.

Welcome to the forum, Doug! We do like photos so show us your shop, tools, projects, etc. whenever you're ready.

Welcome aboard, Doug!

Welcome, Doug!
